title.narrative: Training Program in Environmental Education and Ecological Fair in Allusion to World Environment Day "Solutions to plastic pollution"

description.narrative:
The world is grappling with the issue of protecting and preserving the environment. Climate change is a glaring example, as there are even hotter summers, even colder winters, unusual floods, and many other effects.
The commemorative dates established in the month of June by the United Nations (UN), with the 5th as the "World Environment Day" and the 8th as the "International Oceans Day", raise the world's awareness of the preservation of the environment, through policy measures and the change of society's attitude to ensure sustainable development. In addition, the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO) has been calling on Member States and in particular Ministries of Education to include content related to climate change, with a view to educating students for behavioural changes in their relationship with the environment.
In view of the above, the National Commission of Angola for UNESCO (CNU-Angola), in partnership with Coca-cola, Jimmi, Nação Verde and Refriango, decided to carry out environmental education actions for the schools of the Associated Schools Program, under the motto: "Protect the environment today so that tomorrow can be lived", which will culminate with an Ecological Fair also involving Higher Education Institutions and social partners, with a view to exhibiting a set of projects related to the preservation of the environment.
